assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service is medically necessary given the recurrent dizziness and underlying coronary and valvular disease
This appeal disputes denial code PR-204
